SNOWBALLZ
=========

Start the game with snowballz.exe (Windows) or ./snowballz (Linux).

Windows may say "Windows protected your PC" because the game isn't
signed: click "More info", then "Run anyway". If Windows Firewall asks,
allow it (needed only if YOU host a game).

Joining a friend's game
-----------------------
Main menu -> Join Game. Type the address your friend gives you, e.g.
    81.2.3.4:7777        (over the internet)
    100.101.102.103:7777 (if you both use Tailscale)
and press Connect. Games on your own Wi-Fi show up in the list by
themselves.

Hosting a game
--------------
Main menu -> Host LAN / Internet Game. The lobby shows the addresses
friends can use. The game asks your router to open port 7777. If it
says to forward the port yourself, open your router's settings (or its
app, e.g. Xfinity) and forward TCP port 7777 to your computer.

Playing
-------
Left-drag to select penguins, right-click to send them. Right-click an
enemy igloo with a snowballer selected to take it over. Press F1 in a
game for all the controls, F2 to switch between 3D and the fast 2D view.
